name: cooked
description: Find restaurant inspection records and compare named restaurants with dated official sources.

interface.longDescription: Find named restaurants and compare dated public inspection records in New York, Chicago, Los Angeles County, Las Vegas, Seattle/King County, Austin, Boston, London, Manchester, and Birmingham. Confirm the exact branch, inspect official findings where available, and follow source links. Read-only and accountless. Historical records do not guarantee current safety.
defaultPrompt: Check Katz’s Delicatessen on Houston Street in New York.
Help me choose the correct restaurant branch and check its inspections.
Compare the inspection records of two restaurants.

positive.prompt: Check Katz’s Delicatessen on Houston Street in New York.
positive.expected_behavior: Match the Houston Street address before retrieving it. Show the standing rating and latest inspection separately with dates, source, and pending status if present.

positive.prompt: Check Pret A Manger in London.
positive.expected_behavior: Show candidate addresses and ask which branch. Do not choose a branch or describe its inspection record until the user confirms.

positive.prompt: Compare Katz’s on Houston Street and Russ & Daughters Cafe on Orchard Street in New York.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve both addresses. Display each authority rating and dated inspection evidence side by side, with source links; do not guarantee present-day safety.

positive.description: Follow up on an exact inspection
positive.prompt: For the Katz’s Houston Street restaurant we just selected, explain its latest inspection findings.
positive.expected_behavior: Use an inspection key returned by the selected record. Distinguish passed checks from violations and include exact inspection date and source.

positive.prompt: Check Dishoom on Boundary Street in London and show what its food hygiene rating means.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the branch, display the FHRS rating and available component scores, and explain that the source does not publish itemized violations or full history.

negative.description: Unsupported coverage. Explain that Paris is outside the ten covered regions; do not substitute a same-name restaurant in another city.
negative.prompt: Check restaurant inspection records in Paris.

negative.description: Unsupported action. Explain that Cooked supplies public inspection records and cannot book, pay, or modify restaurant records.
negative.prompt: Book a table for two tonight and pay a deposit.

negative.description: Unwarranted certainty. Explain that dated inspection records cannot guarantee current safety. Offer to show the available evidence and dates.
negative.prompt: Guarantee that this restaurant cannot make me sick.

review.commerce_description: Cooked does not sell products, process payments, or promote paid upgrades.

publication.release_notes: Initial public-data release: restaurant search with branch clarification, restaurant summaries, exact inspections, and comparison cards. Ten existing US and UK regions; free and accountless.
